bibliographic.title: Requiem - An RPG Geek Adventure Across Space and Time
bibliographic.author: Dave Bernazzani, Jaime Lawrence
bibliographic.description: The date is January 1st, 2011. James Alden, time traveler and son of Board Game Geek founder Scott Alden, needs your help... to save the world! Something on The Geek triggered the war to end all wars on January 20th, 2011, and the last remaining survivors of Earth are struggling to stay alive in 2051. Using the powerful Orb of Alden, can you travel through time to stop humanity's impending doom?
